items.title: Naive and direct first-order semantics of second-order generalised algebraic signatures yield isomorphic models
items.author: Ambrus Kaposi; Szumi Xie
items.source_version: FSCD2024 LIPIcs299 article10 pp10:1-10:22, official published CC BY4.0 PDF; Theorem22 p10:15 and necessary published model constructions pp10:10-10:15; native published-range text from author Bitbucket snapshot3c234cec077e
items.difficulty_reason: The author compares two distinct first-order interpretations of SOGAT signatures by using Yoneda as a CwF pseudomorphism and a simultaneous structural induction on contexts, substitutions, types and terms. The non-routine step transports dependent type interpretation across two presheaf levels while preserving the locally representable universe and extracting the closed-signature model isomorphism. The complete printed proof and explicit constructions defining both interpretations are retained; H3 is not asserted.
